title: Comparison of the aesthetic impact on the mandibular angle of two types of osteotomy
html: The growing aesthetic demand for projection and definition of the mandibular angle has challenged oral and maxillofacial surgeons, requiring new approaches to osteotomies during orthognathic surgery. This study was undertaken to compare the conventional sagittal split osteotomy (SSO) with anterior oblique osteotomy (AOO) regarding their effects on the mandibular angle in both bone and soft tissue outcomes. A longitudinal observational cohort study was conducted with patients who underwent orthognathic surgery, including pre- and postoperative computed tomography and photographic examinations with a minimum follow-up interval of 6 months.
